name: Loan Applicant
description: A prospect applying for installment credit, not yet a customer.

name: Borrower
description: A customer repaying an installment loan: pays, asks for payoffs and deferrals, and gets the title back at the end.

name: Card Scheme
description: The network carrying authorization and clearing. An external system we integrate with on their terms, not ours, which is why their availability is a design constraint rather than a requirement.

name: Cardholder
description: The customer. Uses the self-service channels, and is the reason the authorization path has a latency budget rather than a throughput one.

name: Co-Brand Partner
description: A retailer, travel brand or affinity group whose name is on the card. Shares the program's revenue and funds part of its rewards.

name: Collection Agency
description: Works charged-off accounts placed with it under the bank's conduct requirements, and remits what it collects.

name: Collections Agent
description: Handles arrears treatment and payment arrangements.

name: Dealer
description: A dealership selling RVs, boats and powersports vehicles that takes the buyer's loan application and submits it. The bank's point of sale, and a third party it vets, monitors and pays a reserve to.

name: Debt Buyer
description: Buys charged-off accounts in portfolio sales and takes over collecting them.

name: Deposit Broker
description: A broker-dealer that sells the bank's brokered CDs to its own customers and settles them through the depository.

name: Depositor
description: A saver holding a CD or savings account opened directly with the bank.

name: Funding Analyst
description: Reviews contract packages, clears stipulations and releases dealer funding.

name: Independent Sales Organization
description: Brings merchants to the bank and submits their applications. The bank sponsors those merchants into the networks and carries their liability.

name: Merchant
description: Accepts the card at point of sale. Reached through the scheme, never directly.

name: Merchant Onboarding Analyst
description: Reviews a merchant's application and the documents behind it before the account opens.

name: Regulator
description: Consumes periodic regulatory returns. Never integrates directly; the relationship is a reporting obligation with a deadline.

name: Screening Analyst
description: Works the alert queue: clears the false positives and escalates the rest. The queue exists because the screening does, and its volume is the number the vendor's tuning is judged on.

name: Servicing Agent
description: Contact center staff handling balance, dispute and account queries.

name: Servicing Client
description: A lender whose card portfolio the bank services under contract. Sets the strategies, receives the reports and audits the work.

name: Credit Underwriter
description: Reviews referred applications the automated decision would not take.
